card.text: Bright, icy dwarf planet far beyond Neptune.

introduction.text: Eris is about 2,326 km across, nearly the size of Pluto. Its moon is Dysnomia.

color.title: Whole-disc colour and albedo
color.summary: Eris’s measured average colour and brightness, spread evenly. The surface is unresolved: no terrain or markings.

illustration.title: NASA artist's texture
illustration.summary: NASA's illustrated surface from its 3D model. None of it was observed, and its longitudes are arbitrary.
